shellCommands.command: cat package.json; ls; ls app src src/app 2>/dev/null; git status --short | head; cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null; ls lib src/lib 2>/dev/null
cat package.json next.config.ts tsconfig.json; find app -type f | head -50; git status --short; grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json
cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx; ls __agent_eval__; grep -n "after" node_modules/next/server.d.ts; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
f=$(grep -rl "title: after" node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -1); echo $f; sed -n 1,120p "$f"

npx next build 2>&1 | tail -8 && (npx next start -p 3456 > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s localhost:3456 | grep -o '

[^<]*

'; curl -s -o /dev/null localhost:3456; sleep 1; cat /tmp/srv.log; pkill -f "next start" ; git status --short
pgrep -af "next-server|next start" | grep -v pgrep || echo none; git status --short
